10:35 to 13:13 is 2 hours 38 minutes later.  
Subtracting times: 10:35 − 13:13 means time difference from 13:13 to 10:35 earlier same day? No — wrap-around:  
10:35 is 21 hours 22 minutes before next day’s 13:13? Wait, compute directly:  

13:13 − 10:35 = 2:38 (positive means 13:13 is later).  
But question is 10:35 − 13:13 = −2:38.  
Under 24‑hour wrap‑around: add 24 hours: 24:00 − 2:38 = 21:22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 21:22
